responsibility: This header declares GCC’s branch prediction and hotness query interface. It defines predictor probability constants and the br_predictor and prediction enums from predict.def, and exposes APIs for hot/cold classification, optimization-for-size/speed queries on functions/blocks/edges/loops, prediction attachment and removal on CFG edges or RTL insns, probability guessing and rebuilding, and branch-frequency adjustment utilities. It is the public interface to the compiler’s prediction and profile-estimation subsystem.
same_name_distinction: Provides the public enums, probability constants, and function declarations for the prediction subsystem; the heuristic inventory comes from predict.def, while the operational logic lives in predict.cc.
